main_body: A kitchen range seen from the front: a brick chimney on top, a dark slate hood, a steel panel with a dark slot, and a brick base with a glowing fire opening.
top_band: none: the column at x=16 goes from brick chimney (rows 8-19) to a 1-2 row light edge at rows 20-21, then dark slate (L=61, rows 22-25) and a black line at row 26. The dark slate is darker than the front below, not a lighter horizontal top.
evidence: The range reads as a flat architectural elevation. The sloped hood is a dark, narrow, roof-like trapezoid with only a 1-2 row highlight. It is not a lighter horizontal surface seen from above. The steel panel, the brick base and the fire opening are all vertical faces. The chimney is also a plain front face with no visible top. No part of the main body shows a top surface from above, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 13 colours per tile is below the references' 17 and 20. 98% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so it has a near-black sticker-like outline (#0e1216) instead of the tinted material-tone outlines of the references (1% and 33%). Shading is decent on the brick and the fire, but the slate hood and steel panel are shallow ramps with few steps. Its palette and texture are visibly thinner than the references, so it fails.
